column1: # comment: "Expanded temporal kernel alignments \u2014 TemporalFrame / Instant / NamedPeriod / TemporalMeasurement / interval-level Allen JEPD, supersetting OWL-Time, CIDOC-CRM E52/E16, CRMgeo, EDTF Ontology, PeriodO, ICS Geologic Timescale, QUDT, IVOA, and Wikidata BY REFERENCE. TEMPORAL FRAME: GMEOW's TemporalFrame is the temporal counterpart of the spatial ReferenceFrame (reference-frame profile), decomposed into TimeScale + optional CalendarSystem + optional ReferencePosition. It aligns to OWL-Time TRS, CIDOC-CRM E52 Time-Span, and CRMgeo spatiotemporal reference systems. Also includes contextual alignments from temporal-frame design: ReferenceFrame\u2194time:TRS and hasReferenceFrame\u2194time:hasTRS when frameRealm is temporal. INSTANT / EDTF: crisp instantValue is xsd:dateTime; edtfValue is a plain literal (EDTF parsing is solver-layer, P12). Aligned to OWL-Time time:Instant and EDTF Ontology by reference. NAMED PERIOD: aligned to OWL-Time time:ProperInterval, PeriodO periods, and ICS geologic timescale concepts. Geologic period seeds carry skos:exactMatch to ICS by reference. TEMPORAL MEASUREMENT: aligned to CIDOC-CRM E16 Measurement and CRMgeo; dating methods are a value vocabulary mapped to Wikidata QIDs. ALLEN JEPD: interval-level Allen relations are pairwise disjoint; event-level relations are disjoint from interval-level relations. Exhaustiveness lives in the solver layer (P12). CO-EQUAL CALENDARS: Gregorian is one peer among Julian, Hebrew, Islamic, Chinese, Persian, Ethiopian, Coptic, and ISO week (Principle 9)."
